'##############',
'#P....WJW....#',
'#...... W....#',
'#WWWWWW .....#',
'#WWWWWW WWWW.#',

aha: The jellyfish surges at you when you share its column; the upper crossing keeps you in the column for two ticks, so wait beside the shaft until it drifts far away, then cross.
deadlocks: Crossing the upper gap without waiting: the jellyfish surges up the column and stings you.
Pushing the pearl through the shaft bottom while the jellyfish is just above: one tick in its column is enough to get stung.
